name: THE RADIO STATION
rule: VAMILY rules 416 (the big interiors: the tile stays a house), 461 (more boards), 451(a) (its ceiling at 10%), 59 (every tile its cost and its effect), 428, 441.
facts: Paolo 7/6/26 (engine/bohemia_overmap.js, THE RADIO STATION): 'the voice of the valley. No radio, no market. Whoever holds the microphone shapes the truth.' One cell, east of the Strip.
The dead's own line for the kind (engine/bohemia_dead.js): 'somebody stayed on the air'.

A radio station is its studios (the on-air booth and the production rooms behind glass, the engineer's console, the newsroom's desks, the record library's shelves) and its transmitter hall (the transmitter cabinets, the standby generators, the cooling loop, the feed lines on cable trays to the tower).

On house tiles a studio's glass is seen through and never crossed; a rack, a library's shelves, a transmitter or a generator hides a man; the cooling loop's burst water standing on the floor is Battle Brothers' swamp.
how_to_mod: A layout is 15 strings of 20 characters; every character is in 'legend'; every tile kind a legend entry names has its row in 'tiles' (its cost and its effect). A piece names the finished piece it is drawn as ('like') until this folder has its own art file (radio_art.json: floor lists and a kit, the garage's format). slices/bohemia_big_inside.js lays it; slices/fight_ground/insides.json lists the insides.
districts_why: The station is its building: eight fights in ten at its cell are fought inside, in the studios or the transmitter hall, by the cell's own dice; the rest at the tower's foot outside.
share_dice: THE MAP'S DICE (COMBAT FOUR 11/22): a place's inside is rolled from its cell (the same cell the same answer), so a place on a few cells goes inside on a step, never a slope: 'share' is the threshold its real cells need for 'share_meant' to come true over a whole run of valleys, measured on the map's own cells (gates/the_big_insides_gate.js I14). radio: meant 0.8, went inside in 100% of its cells over 40 valleys (5 places, 38 cells, after what the parking garage takes first); at 0.61, 84%, the nearest its dice allow.
tiles_how: Rule 59: every kind of tile says what it costs to step on and what it does. 'row' is the fight's own ground row (flat 2 AP, rough 3, height +1 a level, obstacles none); 'open' is open floor (on AUTO nobody stays on it); 'good' is ground AUTO goes to; 'say' is the one line he reads when he taps it (draft, the fewest words); 'sight' says whether a blocker hides a man ('blocked', the obstacles row) or is seen past ('seen'). [bb] each kind is a Battle Brothers ground: flat, rough, an obstacle, and cover as its trees and walls give it.

wall.effect: The station's block wall, padded inside: no way through, no sight through.

floor.effect: The station's carpet worn to the backing, the hall's bare concrete: open ground, nothing to hide behind; on AUTO nobody stays on it.

rack.effect: An equipment rack floor to ceiling, its lights dead: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it. [bb] its wall.

console.effect: The on-air console, its faders where the last voice left them: cover.

cot.effect: A cot by the microphone, cans and tapes stacked round it: somebody stayed on the air: cover.
cot.say: Somebody stayed on the air: cover.

glass.effect: The studio's double glass: nobody walks through it; a man is seen through it; cover beside it. [bb] its palisade you see through.

cables.effect: Cable runs pulled up out of the floor, a man steps through them: low cover, and slow going (3 AP). [bb] its brush.
cables.say: Cables underfoot: slow going, low cover.

couch.effect: The green room's couch, turned on its back: low cover.

desks.effect: The newsroom's desks and the engineers' consoles, shoved together: cover.

shelves.effect: The record library's shelves, vinyl to the ceiling: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it. [bb] its wall.

crates.effect: Crates of records and spare tubes, stacked: cover.

transmitter.effect: A transmitter's cabinets, taller than a man, still warm when the generators run: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it; cover beside it. [bb] its wall.

generator.effect: A standby generator on its skid: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it; cover beside it. [bb] its boulder.

drums.effect: Diesel drums for the generators: low cover.

bench.effect: The engineers' workbench, a tube tester and a soldering iron on it: cover.

leak.effect: The cooling loop burst, water standing on the floor: slow going (4 AP), and a man standing in it fights worse. [bb] its swamp.
leak.say: Standing water: slow going, and you fight worse in it.

fire.effect: A fire somebody keeps in a drum. It burns day and night: a man in its light is seen.
fire.say_lit: A fire: you stand in its light, and they see you.

doors.effect: The station's doors, open onto the lot and the tower's foot: open ground, and by day the light falls in: a man here is seen.
doors.say_lit: The doors: open ground, and the day is on you.

kit_how: Every piece is drawn AS a finished piece of another kit ('like') until COOK's own picture for it is in radio_art.json under the same name: then that picture is used and nothing here changes. 'kind' is what it does in the fight (COVER, LOW_COVER, WALL); 'blocks_move' means nobody stands on its tile.
start_why: NO HIGH GROUND: the station is one floor; the tower is outside and its climb is a ladder nobody makes under fire.

ceiling.how: VAMILY rule 451(a): the studios' acoustic tiles and the transmitter hall's cable trays, over the board at this alpha. 'src' is the picture COOK makes; 'have' true the day it is in the folder. Until then the fight draws 'kind' itself, a stand-in (the warehouse's roof).
